title: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.31288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growth of time-series datasets and foundation models has made dataset comparison a central part of time-series workflows. Assessing source-target transfer before model adaptation requires similarity estimates that can summarize transfer-related dataset relationships without exhaustive source-target evaluation over every candidate pair. Many metrics have been proposed for measuring similarity between time-series datasets, but they capture different dataset relationships and vary in how well they align with downstream utility across tasks. We evaluate this gap by measuring the correlation between source-target similarity scores and downstream forecasting errors in out-of-distribution and transfer-learning settings. We propose Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost (DISC), a learnable aggregation framework that uses calibration transfer observations to select, weight, and combine similarity metrics for different downstream tasks. translated_title: DISC：面向时间序列数据集的域集成相似性代价
translated_abstract: 时间序列数据集和基础模型的增长使得数据集比较成为时间序列工作流程的核心环节。在模型适应之前评估源域到目标域的迁移，需要能够概括与迁移相关的数据集关系的相似性估计，而无需对每一个候选数据集对进行穷举式的源-目标评估。目前已有许多度量方法被提出用于衡量时间序列数据集之间的相似性，但它们所捕捉的数据集关系各不相同，且在不同任务上与下游效用的一致程度也存在差异。我们通过测量分布外设置和迁移学习设置下源-目标相似性得分与下游预测误差之间的相关性，来评估这一差距。我们提出了域集成相似性代价（DISC），这是一个可学习的聚合框架，利用校准迁移观测来为不同的下游任务选择、加权和组合相似性度量。通过集成……
tldr: 提出了DISC——一个可学习的相似性度量聚合框架，利用校准迁移观测为不同下游任务自动选择、加权和组合多种相似性度量，使源-目标相似性得分与下游预测误差的关联更加一致，从而无需穷举评估即可实现数据集迁移性比较。
en_tdlr: DISC is a learnable aggregation framework that uses calibration transfer observations to select, weight, and combine similarity metrics for different downstream tasks, better aligning source-target similarity scores with downstream forecasting errors without exhaustive source-target evaluation.
